topic: Visiting my grandparents in the countryside
coach_rationale: 今天继续盯你最顽固的两处：过去式 -ed 结尾（waited、cooked、remembered、showed、helped、packed、promised）和动词短语连读（set off、sit down、pick up、check on、drop by、grow up）。Mac 直读 EnglishPod365 笔记：自 10 月 16 日 EP0012 后仍无新内容，弱项仍是 fill me in、kicked me out、pick up a 这类连读短语和 we've/It'll 缩写时态，所以本篇把乡下探亲场景里的短语动词密度拉高，先在慢速 TTS 里把尾音和连读听清楚。网站听写表仍为空、EnglishPod 新版也无错题记录，B1 难度有分样本仍只有 1 次，今天这篇继续补样本。
passage: Last Saturday morning, my wife and I set off early to visit my grandparents in the countryside. Although the bus ride took almost two hours, we enjoyed the green fields and small villages along the way. My grandfather waited for us at the gate and waved to us with a big smile. He is eighty years old, but he still looked strong and walked quickly. My grandmother cooked a big lunch and asked us to sit down at the old wooden table. We tasted her dumplings and talked about my childhood in the village. She remembered that I used to climb the big tree behind the house, and she laughed when she told my wife about it. After lunch, my grandfather showed us his vegetable garden and picked up a basket of fresh tomatoes for us. We helped him water the plants and checked on the chickens in the yard. Before we left, my grandmother packed some eggs and asked us to come back soon. On the way home, I looked at the photos on my phone and felt warm inside. I grew up in that village, and I promised to drop by more often.
